title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Trailer Hypes Crunchyroll Streaming Release – Watch Now
content: Dragon Ball Super is only a few days away from the anime’s return with a new remake series , and Crunchyroll is gearing up for the remake’s streaming release with a new trailer.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Magical Girl Recruiter Puicho!, Bitter Knight in My Sweet Café, 3 More Manga
content: Manga UP! Global added the following manga over the past two weeks: But among the customers who gather for their love of cute things, there's a peculiar one who only orders black coffee every morning: Arthur Villand, the frightening and ruthless knight commander. And the reason he comes to the cafe is...?!
author: ANN

title: Eva Marie Saint, Superman Returns & Legend of Korra Actress, Dead at 102
content: Eva Marie Saint, the iconic actress from Hollywood’s golden era, has passed away. Reps for the actress confirmed to Deadline that she died at her home in Los Angeles, “surrounded by family and loved ones.” They confirmed that Saint died of natural causes. She was 102.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 2 Preview and Synopsis Revealed
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 2 (Episode 172 overall) ahead of its October 10 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kagurabachi Anime Casts Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami, New Character Trailer and Visual Revealed
content: KAGURABACHI anime has cast Yuichi Nakamura as Soshiro Azami, introducing the character with a new visual and dedicated trailer. Nakamura’s casting joins the previously announced main cast ahead of the anime’s April 2027 premiere.
author: Anime Corner

title: Exclusive: Viz Hosts Signing Tour for GalaXic Baseball League Comic Artist Acky Bright
content: Viz Media announced on Wednesday a signing tour across the United States for the GalaXic Baseball League comic series — Viz's collaboration with MLB Players, Inc., OneTeam Partners, and the BW NYC Studios of Japanese artist Acky Bright. The tour will start on October 13, the release date of the comic's first volume.
author: ANN

title: Walking Home with You Anime Unveils April 2027 TV Debut
content: The official website for the anime of Mai Matsuda 's Walking Home with You ( Hōkago Kitaku Biyori ) manga opened on Wednesday and confirmed the anime's television format. The website also unveiled the anime's teaser visual and April 2027 premiere on the NTV channel.
author: ANN

title: Code Geass: Lost Stories Game to End Service on December 7
content: The official website for the Code Geass : Lost Stories social game announced on Wednesday that the game will end service on December 7. Sales of the in-game Sakuradite currency, Lost Stories Pass, and Starter Pack has also ended on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint Returns as Cygames and Breeders’ Cup Renew Partnership
content: Cygames, Inc. has renewed its partnership with the Breeders’ Cup for the third consecutive year. Under the agreement, the weekend’s sprint race will be named the Cygames Breeders’ Cup Sprint.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Moon on a Rainy Night Anime's 1st Video Reveals Cast, More Staff
content: The official website for the television anime of Kuzushiro 's The Moon on a Rainy Night ( Amayo no Tsuki ) manga began streaming the anime's first full promotional video on Wednesday. The video announces the anime's main cast members, as well as more staff members.
author: ANN
